description: The entries of the near-life database kp-test-numbers.kdbx: an address book as a person keeps it, one number per entry, written in the formats people really use. Hand-kept. The stored text is the value of tel-values.json named by `value`; the links an entry must show are the expected links of the code cases with that value. All numbers are fictional. make_near_life.py builds near-life-spec.json and the database from this file.
title: Near-life

entries.title: Hotel Lindenhof front desk
entries.what: International form, written without separators.

entries.title: Praxis Dr Beispiel
entries.what: International form, written with hyphens.

entries.title: Buchhandlung Sonnenschein
entries.what: International form, written with dots.

entries.title: Taxi Musterstadt
entries.what: The area code in brackets, no spaces.

entries.title: Stadtwerke Hotline
entries.what: International form with spaces between the groups.
entries.remedy: Remove the spaces inside the number: tel:+493023125567.

entries.title: Reisebuero Nordlicht
entries.what: International form with the national prefix (0) in brackets and spaces.
entries.remedy: Remove the spaces and the (0): tel:+493023125567.

entries.title: Autohaus Weber
entries.what: International form with the national prefix (0) in brackets, no spaces.
entries.remedy: Leave out the (0) after the country code: tel:+493023125567.

entries.title: Friseur Haarscharf
entries.what: National form with a slash after the area code.
entries.remedy: Write the number in international form, with the country code and without the slash: tel:+49301234567.

entries.title: Baeckerei Korn
entries.what: National form, only digits.
entries.remedy: Replace the leading 0 by the country code: tel:+493023125567.

entries.title: Nachbar Sued
entries.what: Written with the international call prefix 00.
entries.remedy: Replace the leading 00 by a plus: tel:+493023125567.

entries.title: Zahnarzt Lachen
entries.what: National form with the area code in brackets and a space.
entries.remedy: Write the number in international form, without brackets and space: tel:+493023125567.

entries.title: Kanzlei Recht und Ordnung
entries.what: International form with the trunk zero kept after the country code.

entries.title: Pizzeria Bella Roma New Jersey
entries.what: International form with hyphens, the number in groups of three, three and four digits.

entries.title: Diner Route Nine
entries.what: International form with the area code in brackets and spaces.
entries.remedy: Remove the spaces and the brackets: tel:+12015550100.

entries.title: Switchboard with extension
entries.what: An extension carried as a parameter of the link.
entries.remedy: The extension is not passed on: link the main number and write the extension next to it as plain text.

entries.title: Hospital desk with subaddress
entries.what: An ISDN subaddress carried as a parameter of the link.
entries.remedy: The subaddress is not passed on: link the main number and write the subaddress next to it as plain text.

entries.title: Office with pause and extension
entries.what: A comma after the number: a pause, then the extension digits.
entries.remedy: The digits after the comma are not passed on: link the main number and write the extension next to it as plain text.

entries.title: Office extension with hyphens
entries.what: An extension written as a last group of the number.
entries.remedy: The extension is dialled as part of the number: write tel:+493023125567 and the extension apart, as plain text.

entries.title: Sentence with extension
entries.what: A number with an extension inside a sentence.
entries.remedy: The extension is not passed on: link the main number and write the extension as plain text.

entries.title: Extension and subaddress
entries.what: Both parameters in one link: not allowed by the standard.
entries.remedy: A link may have an extension or a subaddress, not both: link the main number and write both as plain text.

entries.title: Office local number with context
entries.what: A local number with an extension and the context of its country.
entries.remedy: A local number with a context is not linked: write the full international number, tel:+493023125567.

entries.title: Local number with context
entries.what: A local number with the context of its country.
entries.remedy: A local number with a context is not linked: write the full international number, tel:+493023125567.

entries.title: Company internal number
entries.what: An internal number with the domain of the company as its context.
entries.remedy: An internal number has no country code and is not linked: keep it as text and dial it from the company phone.

entries.title: Emergency number with context
entries.what: An emergency number with the context of its country.
entries.remedy: Not linked: dial the emergency number from the phone's own dialer.

entries.title: Emergency number Europe
entries.what: The three-digit emergency number 112, written alone.
entries.remedy: Not linked: dial the emergency number from the phone's own dialer.

entries.title: Emergency number USA
entries.what: The three-digit emergency number 911, written alone.
entries.remedy: Not linked: dial the emergency number from the phone's own dialer.

entries.title: Short number
entries.what: A four digit service number, written alone.
entries.remedy: A short number has no country code and is not linked: dial it from the phone's own dialer.

entries.title: Hotline with opening hours
entries.what: A number inside text, followed by opening hours in brackets.

entries.title: Two numbers office and mobile
entries.what: Two numbers in one field, each with its label.

entries.title: Number then web address
entries.what: A number followed by a web address.

entries.title: Web address then number
entries.what: A web address followed by a number.

entries.title: Number after e-mail address
entries.what: An e-mail address followed by a number.

entries.title: Call now
entries.what: A number inside a short sentence.

entries.title: Number in brackets
entries.what: A number in round brackets.

entries.title: Number in quotation marks
entries.what: A number in quotation marks.

entries.title: Number with full stop
entries.what: A number at the end of a sentence.

entries.title: Number with comma
entries.what: A number followed by a comma in a list.

entries.title: Number then emoji
entries.what: A number followed by an emoji.

entries.title: Number split by line break
entries.what: A number with a line break inside it.
entries.remedy: Write the whole number on one line: tel:+493023125503301234.

entries.title: Upper case TEL
entries.what: The prefix in capital letters.

entries.title: Capitalised Tel
entries.what: The prefix with a capital first letter.

entries.title: Country code only
entries.what: A plus and a country code, no number.
entries.remedy: A number needs digits after the country code: tel:+493023125567.

entries.title: Too many digits
entries.what: More digits than a telephone number can have.
entries.remedy: A telephone number has at most 15 digits: check the number.

entries.title: Leading zero country code
entries.what: A plus followed by zero: no country starts with 0.
entries.remedy: No country code starts with 0: tel:+493023125567.

entries.title: Double plus
entries.what: Two plus signs.
entries.remedy: Write the plus once: tel:+49301234.

entries.title: Percent encoded plus
entries.what: The plus written as %2B, as in a web address.
entries.remedy: Write a plain plus, not %2B: tel:+49301234.

entries.title: Full width plus
entries.what: The plus written as a full width character.
entries.remedy: Write a plain plus, not the wide character: tel:+49301234.

entries.title: Hidden right to left control
entries.what: An invisible control character after the number.
entries.remedy: Delete the invisible character after the number and type it again: tel:+4930123.

entries.title: No-break space inside
entries.what: A no-break space inside the number.
entries.remedy: Remove the space inside the number: tel:+49301234.

entries.title: Tab inside
entries.what: A tab inside the number.
entries.remedy: Remove the tab inside the number: tel:+49301234.
